wallet.noAccessText: Ask the account owner to give you finance access.

balance.availableHint: Everything in your wallet right now
balance.oweHint: Your fees are more than the cash we collected. The {amount} is taken from the cash we collect for you next.

breakdown.processingHint: Orders completed today. They join a cash cycle at 11:59 PM.
breakdown.inNextCashOutHint: Closed cash cycles waiting to go to your bank

days.weekly: Closed cash cycles go to your bank every Monday.

days.daily: Closed cash cycles go to your bank Sunday to Thursday.

next.title: Next cash-out
next.noBank: Add a bank account so we can send your money.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.hint: Every delivered or returned order adds a row. Cash-outs to your bank show here too.
transactions.emptyText: Your wallet fills up as your orders are delivered.

reasonExplain.order_delivered: The cash your courier collected for this order, minus Shiply fees. It goes to your bank with the cash cycle of the day it was delivered.
reasonExplain.order_returned: Shiply fees for this order, taken from your wallet because it came back to you.
reasonExplain.cash_out_paid: Money sent from your wallet to your bank account.
reasonExplain.other: A change to your wallet balance.

drawer.proofHint: Bank reference, amount and the cash cycles it covers

cashOuts.title: Cash-outs
cashOuts.hint: Every transfer from your wallet to your bank.
cashOuts.emptyText: Your first cash-out shows here on your next cash-out day.

cycles.title: Cash cycles
cycles.hint: Each cash cycle closes at 11:59 PM with all orders completed that day.
cycles.emptyText: Your first cash cycle closes at 11:59 PM on the day an order is delivered.

how.title: How cash-outs work

collect.title: Your courier collects cash
collect.text: When the customer pays on delivery

close.title: The cash cycle closes
close.text: Every night at 11:59 PM, with all orders completed that day

fees.title: Shiply fees are taken
fees.text: Shipping, extras and VAT for those orders

cashOutText.twice_weekly: On your schedule: Monday and Wednesday
cashOutText.daily: On your schedule: every working day, Sunday to Thursday

how.note: If your fees are more than the cash collected, the difference is taken from your next cash collections.

proof.title: Proof of transfer
proof.note: Issued by Shiply for your records. Give the bank reference to your bank if you need to trace this payment.
proof.receiptOnFile: The bank's receipt is on file with Shiply.
